entities.summary: Pyotr Petrovich Pertsov was a Russian poet, publisher, editor, literary critic, journalist and memoirist associated with the Russian Symbolist movement. Pyotr Pertsov was a journalists & chroniclers from Kazan (1868-06-16, Kazan–1947-05-19). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
